utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — I’ll help collect the donations and sort them at the table this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks Sam — I’ll be there Saturday around 9 and can help sort at the table too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, Leo — see you Saturday around 9, and I’ll bring everything I can to help sort and get things set up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll meet you at my place at 9, then we can head over together. I’ve got the wrench set, screwdriver, gloves, and hammer ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll be there at your place on Maple at 9. Thanks for bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, see you then — I’ll have everything ready at 9 on Maple.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check the list and get you the exact fixes and meeting spot soon—thanks for being patient.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah—no rush. Just let me know the exact items and where to meet when you’ve checked the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do—I’ll check and send you the exact fixes and meeting spot as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Vik — I’ll ask around for broken items and any repair skills folks have. Let me know if you want me to remind anyone too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up again and keep the repair drive on everyone’s mind.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I’ll keep asking around and let you know if I hear of any broken items or handy folks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the screwdriver, tape, and spare nails ready for the repair drive. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo—thanks! Please bring them to the community center on Sunday, and if anyone has other broken items or repair skills, send them along too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll bring the tools to the community center on Sunday and pass along the word about broken items and repair skills too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sunday at the community center, right? I still need the pickup time and a clear count of what’s being loaded so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — I’m bringing a few things too, and I’ll send you the pickup time plus a clear count shortly so we can keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once you send the pickup time and count, I can help keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — we’re still on for today, and I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive spot in case anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm—are you covering anything for the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of what comes in and where it goes, and I’ll bring tape if I can. If you need anything specific covered, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll keep you posted, Mara — if anything else turns up for the repair drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate it. Just keep me posted, and we’ll see if anything else is needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Mara — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard they could still use a few more hands and maybe some supplies too. Do you know what they’re short on right now?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds like they could still use a few more hands, and maybe some supplies too. I’d check with Mara about the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll ask Mara for the latest list, then. If you hear anything else, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just tell me the first thing that needs fixing, and keep me posted if the repair drive spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning around 9 still works for me. I’ll keep you posted if the spot changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Saturday at 9 works for me too. Just let me know the first repair when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No problem, Mina — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks Uli — do you need me to bring any tools or supplies for Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, I should be okay — just having you there helps. Thanks, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — I’m just catching up, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or follow up on?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — if you can bring any spare tools or help spread the word, that’d be great. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can round up some spare tools and spread the word a bit more. If you hear of any good leads, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that too — I’ll bring some tape and a few spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Jules — that’ll really help keep the repair drive moving. I’ll pass it along and let you know if I hear anything else useful.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — just let me know if anything else turns up, and I’m happy to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just wanted to confirm—are you covering anything for the repair drive too?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check what’s still needed—are you missing any tools or supplies for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yes, could you confirm what’s still needed? I just want to know if I should cover anything too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that — I’ll quietly mention Saturday around 9 to a few neighbors. If I hear a good drop-off spot, I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — that would be great. Saturday around 9 is still the plan, and I’ll be glad to hear about any good drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear a good drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’m covering the school side and I’ll check in on Leo’s piece too. Let’s start with the school items first, then we can see what else the drive needs.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I'll sort the school items first and set aside anything that needs repair.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Leo. I’ll coordinate the school side and circle back after we see what needs repair.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep bringing it up so the repair drive stays on everyone’s mind.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep bringing it up with folks and remind them to share any broken items or repair skills they’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll pass it along — 10 a.m. at the corner lot. Do they still need any extra volunteers or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 a.m. at the corner lot works for me. If you still need an extra hand, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I’ll let folks know you can help too. If I hear about any extra supplies needed, I’ll pass that along as well.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the screwdriver, tape, and spare nails set aside, so we should be set for the repair drive. If anything else comes up, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Cleo — I’m on my way to the corner lot now and I’ll help get everything loaded up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — I’ll head over with the screwdriver, tape, and nails now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — I’m just catching up, so if you’ve got any tape, nails, or a screwdriver, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can swing by with a screwdriver, tape, and some nails for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That’d be fantastic, Gus — thanks a lot. I really appreciate you pitching in on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks for the update—Sunday at the community center works, but do we have the pickup time and a clear count of what’s being loaded?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don’t have the pickup time yet, but I can ask around and get back to you. I’ll also check on the load count so we know what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli. Please let me know as soon as you have it—I just want to keep everything organized for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just keep me posted if the location changes or timing shifts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything shifts. And I can bring you the latest on what folks are donating later, too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess—just the donation update is fine for now. If anything changes, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m still spreading the word about the repair drive, and I’ll keep an ear out for anyone who needs help. Hope we get a great turnout.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn. Before I help, could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mostly small household fixes—loose hinges, squeaky doors, patching things up, and any little repairs neighbors have been putting off. If you hear of anyone who needs help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — I’m still keeping an eye on the repair drive spot, and I’ll let you know right away if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do — I’ll pass along any updates I catch about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — I’ll do the same and keep watching the repair drive location.
